bio.text: Rosilicie Ochoa Bogh was elected to the California State Senate in November 2020 and re-elected in November 2024 to the newly drawn 19th Senate District, which covers communities in Riverside and San Bernardino counties.

She is a native Californian and the daughter of Mexican immigrants, and graduated from the University of California, Santa Barbara, then earned a teaching credential at California State University, San Bernardino.
Before the Senate she taught English language learners at the elementary level, worked as a Realtor for more than 20 years, and served on the Yucaipa-Calimesa Joint Unified School District board.
